name: Tokyo Mermaid
source:
Tokyo survived a massive earthquake, and the ruins of it turned into an illegal zone. 

Langhao and her sister Mika, a cosplay masochistic young lady, encounter a mysterious cat girl creature. The three people start to travel together and notice the shadow of a mysterious organization. Nonstop erotic survival battle develops in Tokyo set into ruins. What is the true identity of a cat girl? And what is the conspiracy behind the mysterious organization?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
